numeric_contract.input: Finite JSON int or float, excluding bool. Integer-valued float canonicalizes to int.
numeric_contract.comparison: Exact Fraction of int or shortest decimal str(float), area squared, oriented normal comparison with sign handling.
numeric_contract.bounds: 0 <= area_min_m2 <= area_max_m2 and -1 <= normal_z_min <= 1, all equalities included.
numeric_contract.unsupported: Nonrectangular components remain in original scene and occlusion geometry.

quality.local_source: Same actual captured world vertices, per-object triangle rows, object order and full scene occluders. Each scope keeps its own camera and current frame identities.
quality.witness: Source-bound geometry-complete view and actual readable pixels are jointly required. Predicted skip bounds alone never satisfy image evidence.
quality.selected_delivery: Global overview and two open target witness native PNGs, all three may be named SCENE and are identified by scope/image_ref/frame_identity/camera identity.
quality.constructed_archive: Every constructed frame is retained and costed, including frames omitted from native image delivery.

optimized.skip_rule: After real global SCENE, skip an unconstructed global direction only when a conservative actual-matrix pixel-center upper bound is strictly below 16 for every remaining task region that can benefit. Keep uncertain cases in the existing path.

performance.service_interval: Same producer super.observe start through returned result, with construction and source processing included.
performance.client_and_parent_intervals: Report separately alongside service and complete owned lifecycle. Do not substitute a local algorithm timer.
performance.if_not_admitted: Retain the initial functional version and close this performance candidate.

calls.before: Owned unsaved fixture copy Obj_02 matrix translation +0.25m world X
Restore Obj_02 original identity matrix in the same owned unsaved copy

state_compatibility.mutations: Fixture-only owned unsaved state changes. Product exposes no setters and never saves the original asset.
state_compatibility.same_state: Repeated full and brief calls must reference cached results and real cached images without new construction.
state_compatibility.changed_condition: The z=1 task excludes the inclined region and its local witness. Task identity and cache key must distinguish it.

scope_limits: One fixed asset and task domain
No generic nonrectangular source mapping conclusion
Numerically ambiguous exact triangle tie ownership stays explicit
